threat_event: Malicious script in a merchant-customized storefront theme skims card data around the hosted fields
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tamper-detection covers the standard template only
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (tamper-detection covers the standard template only); EV-073 (Software risk interviews)
treatment_plan: Extend script inventory and tamper-detection to all themes; content security policy defaults (POAM-015)

threat_event: A compromised or malicious marketplace app injects scripts into thousands of storefronts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 260 apps can add scripts; review only at listing
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (about 260 apps can add scripts; review at listing only)
treatment_plan: Re-review script-capable apps; runtime script monitoring; kill switch per app (POAM-016)

threat_event: ISV API credentials read from the support console are used for card testing or fraudulent refunds
threat_source: Attacker with support or consulting access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Keys shown in clear to support and integration staff
likelihood_basis: EV-059 (keys shown in clear; standing consulting access)
treatment_plan: Mask keys; rotate on view; remove consulting access (POAM-018)

threat_event: Gateway region failure stops processing for more than 4 hours
Gateway logs or analytics capture PAN again
likelihood_basis: EV-079 (debug field wrote PAN from 2026-05-08 to 2026-06-18; PAN block extended 2026-06-30)
existing_controls: PAN block on all log sources (2026-06-20); log field review in code review
treatment_plan: Automated test that fails builds on PAN in log fields

threat_event: Tenant isolation defect exposes one merchant's customer data to another
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared database with tenant filters in code
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (tenant isolation tests on each release); EV-073 (Software risk interviews)

threat_event: Prompt injection or cross-merchant leakage in the merchant insights assistant exposes customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No red-team test; per-merchant scoping in prompts only
likelihood_basis: EV-080 (per-merchant scoping in prompts; zero-retention contract); EV-073 (Software risk interviews)
treatment_plan: Red-team test; output filtering; per-merchant retrieval enforcement (P10)

threat_event: Assistant missing from the SOC 2 system description leads to exceptions or customer distrust
likelihood_basis: EV-080 (released 2026-05-12 without description review); EV-055 (2025 system description)
treatment_plan: Describe the feature and model provider in the 2026 description; merchant notice (POAM-017)
owner: Software division client trust and assurance director

threat_event: Device management compromise pushes malicious point-of-sale software
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Signed updates; admin access through PAM

threat_event: Gateway routes to an unaffiliated processor whose AOC has lapsed
likelihood_basis: EV-028 (annual AOC tracking for unaffiliated processors)

threat_event: No published responsibility matrix for ISVs leads to gaps and disputes after an incident
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (ISV questions answered case by case; no published matrix)
owner: Software division client trust and assurance director

threat_event: Release pipeline compromise inserts malicious code into the gateway
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (signed builds; two approvals); EV-073 (Software risk interviews)

threat_event: CCPA cybersecurity audit or ADMT duties are missed for merchant customer data
regulatory_driver: N51-R03 (Cal. Code Regs. tit. 11, 7120-7124; ADMT rules)

threat_event: Merchant administrator accounts on the commerce SaaS taken over
likelihood_basis: EV-073 (merchant account takeover accounts; MFA optional for merchant users)
treatment_plan: MFA required for merchant administrators by 2027-03-31
Accepted: Low with PAM in place

threat_event: 24-hour ISV notice missed after a credential incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ISV contact list not in the out-of-band binder
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (24-hour ISV notice); EV-023 (out-of-band binder contents)
treatment_plan: ISV contacts in the notification matrix and binder
owner: Software division client trust and assurance director

threat_event: Marketplace apps export merchant customer data beyond their stated permissions
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (marketplace apps reviewed at listing); EV-073 (Software risk interviews)
